claim: Oura's API V2 is the only available integration point for Oura data.
quote: This document describes the Oura API Version 2 (V2), which is the only available integration point for Oura data.

claim: Oura users authorize over OAuth 2.0.
quote: The Oura Cloud API supports authentication through the industry-standard OAuth2 protocol.

claim: Oura marks PKCE as recommended.
quote: code_challenge Recommended PKCE code challenge.

claim: Oura users consent per data type.
quote: Oura users **must provide consent** to share each data type an API Application has access to.

claim: Oura calls webhooks the preferred way to consume its data.
quote: Webhooks are the preferred way to consume Oura data

claim: Heart rate comes in 5-minute increments.
quote: Heart rate is provided at 5-minute increments.

claim: SpO2 is for Gen 3 rings.
quote: Data will only be available for users with a Gen 3 Oura Ring

claim: Stress data.
quote: The daily stress route includes a summary of the number of minutes the user spends in high stress and high recovery each day.

claim: Resilience data.
quote: Resilience is an estimate of your ability to withstand physiological stress and recover from it over time.

claim: Cardiovascular age.
quote: Cardiovascular Age is an estimate of the health of your cardiovascular system in relation to your actual age.

claim: VO2 max.
quote: VO2 Max is a measure of the maximum volume of oxygen that an individual can use during intense exercise.

claim: New apps are limited to 10 users until Oura approves them.
quote: By default, API Applications have a ten user limit. If you want to release your application to a wider audience, your application needs to be approved.

claim: No limit after approval.
quote: There is no limit once an application is approved.

claim: 5,000 requests per 5-minute period.
quote: The Oura API is limited to 5000 requests per 5-minute period.

claim: Oura's error docs give the same limit.
quote: The API V1 and V2 API are rate limited to 5000 requests in a 5 minute period.

claim: 403 when the user's subscription has expired.
quote: The requested resource requires additional permissions or the user's Oura subscription has expired.

claim: Oura's FAQ says the API is free for personal and commercial use.
quote: Yes, the Oura API is free to use for both personal and commercial applications.

claim: Oura membership is $5.99 USD a month before tax in the US.
quote: $5.99 USD/month or $69.99 USD/annually before tax for US members,

claim: Ultrahuman documents the UltraSignal API for metrics from Ultrahuman devices.
quote: Welcome to the UltraSignal API documentation. This API provides comprehensive access to health and fitness metrics collected by Ultrahuman devices.

claim: Ultrahuman makes a ring.
quote: The most powerful Ultrahuman Ring, yet

claim: The daily metrics endpoint.
quote: https://partner.ultrahuman.com/api/v1/partner/daily_metrics

claim: Date ranges cannot exceed 7 days.
quote: Date range queries cannot exceed 7 days

claim: A date or an epoch range, not both.
quote: choose either date or epoch timestamps, not both

claim: Create a personal API token in the developer portal.
quote: Create your Personal API token from the developer portal

claim: Your own data needs no extra setup.
quote: If you want to access data for your own account (same email as your login), no additional setup is required.

claim: Other users' data needs their email and authorization in the Ultrahuman app.
quote: Their email address (to be used as a parameter in the API)

claim: Users enter the data sharing code under Partner ID.
quote: Enter the data sharing code provided by the API developer

claim: The Partner ID setting is under Profile, Settings.
quote: Go to Profile tab → Settings → Partner ID

claim: Anyone with the token can use the API as you.
quote: Anyone with this Authorization Key can use the Ultrahuman API as you.

claim: Metrics include HRV, sleep stages, recovery and VO2 max.
quote: hrv Heart Rate Variability - a measure of the variation in time between heartbeats

claim: Metrics include skin temperature.
quote: temp Skin temperature readings in Celsius

claim: Metrics include glucose averages and time in target.
quote: time_in_target Percentage of time glucose levels stayed within target range

claim: Metrics include SpO2.
quote: spo2 Blood oxygen saturation levels, measured as a percentage

claim: OAuth app setup is shown after login.
quote: Want to access your personal tokens and create OAuth apps? Login to view authenticated documentation

claim: The docs have OAuth and MCP tabs.
quote: API Docs OAuth Docs MCP Docs

claim: Galaxy Ring data transfers to the paired phone's Samsung Health app.
quote: Health data in the Samsung Health app can also be collected from connected devices, like the Galaxy Watch or Galaxy Ring, which automatically transfers its data to a paired mobile phone’s Samsung Health app.

claim: The Data SDK reads selected data in Samsung Health's data store.
quote: An app using the SDK can access selected health data of the Samsung Health’s data store.

claim: Each data point names its source device.
quote: Each data point has data source information including the device ID indicating which device provided the health data.

claim: Samsung Health 6.30.2 or later.
quote: Samsung Health Data SDK requires Samsung Health version 6.30.2 or later.

claim: Android 10 or later.
quote: Samsung Health runs on devices with Android 10 (API level 29) or later.

claim: A released app needs partnership approval registering package name and signature.
quote: Please submit partner request before your app distribution. Your app's information including the app package name and signature (SHA-256) will be registered in the Samsung Health's system after an approval.

claim: RingConn's site lists its rings.
quote: Entry-level smart ring, core health features included

claim: RingConn's site lists user manuals.
quote: RingConn Gen 3 Smart Ring User Manual
